title: Goat Sensor Lab annotations-v1.csv contract
description: Canonical append-only table for independent, time-aligned rater annotations. These records, not live labels copied into samples.csv, are the source observations for research ground truth.

columns.name: annotation_id
columns.description: Globally unique immutable annotation record ID.

columns.name: rater_id
columns.description: Pseudonymous annotator or adjudicator ID; the identity key is held separately.

columns.name: label
columns.description: Ethogram code valid for the selected head and ethogram version.

columns.name: offset_monotonic_ns
columns.description: Exclusive segment end; blank only for a point event.

columns.name: media_id
columns.description: ID of the immutable source video/audio artifact; blank only when media_clock is NONE.

columns.name: clock_mapping_id
columns.description: Versioned sensor-to-media clock mapping used to derive monotonic times.

columns.name: supersedes_annotation_id
columns.description: Previous immutable record replaced by this revision; blank for an original record.

columns.name: adjudication_id
columns.description: Immutable adjudication episode ID; blank before review.

label_rules.EVENT: Use a code defined by the referenced ethogram version. Clinical outcomes belong in a separate clinical-outcomes artifact.

row_rules: Never modify or delete a published row; corrections append a new annotation_id and point supersedes_annotation_id to the prior row.
annotation_id is globally unique and supersedes links must be acyclic, remain within one session, animal, rater, and head, and increase revision by one.
offset_monotonic_ns is exclusive and must be greater than onset_monotonic_ns for state annotations; it is blank only for point events.
Media-backed annotations require media_id, media position fields, and a versioned clock_mapping_id.
Every media_id and clock_mapping_id resolves to the same experiment-manifest camera entry, whose media and clock-mapping artifacts have immutable SHA-256 digests.
Independent raters must have distinct rater_id values and must not inspect model predictions or each other's labels before their tracks are frozen.
Later agreement or adjudication does not erase original rater rows; append adjudication-linked revisions and derive consensus separately.
Consensus cites active, non-superseded annotation IDs; ADJUDICATED segments cite at least two independent raters and one matching ADJUDICATOR_RECORD.
CLINICALLY_CONFIRMED_ABNORMAL is intentionally absent: clinical outcomes require a separate provenance-rich clinical protocol artifact.
